name: companies
sql:
CREATE TABLE companies (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	invite_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_companies_invite_code ON companies (invite_code)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_companies_name ON companies (name)

name: customers
sql:
CREATE TABLE customers (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	contact_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL, 
	phone VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	address TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id)
)

name: users
sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_email ON users (email)

name: audit_events
sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_events (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	action VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	entity_type VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	entity_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	detail_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

name: jobs
sql:
CREATE TABLE jobs (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	engineer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	customer VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	reference VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	product VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	system_name VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	fault TEXT NOT NULL, 
	module VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	diagnosis TEXT NOT NULL, 
	confidence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	recommendation TEXT NOT NULL, 
	work_done TEXT NOT NULL, 
	parts_required TEXT NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	engineer_notes TEXT NOT NULL, 
	signature VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	approved_by_engineer BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(engineer_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

name: notifications
sql:
CREATE TABLE notifications (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	body TEXT NOT NULL, 
	read BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

name: approval_requests
sql:
CREATE TABLE approval_requests (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	requested_by_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	approval_type VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	estimated_cost_pence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	decision_by_id INTEGER, 
	decision_note TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(requested_by_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(decision_by_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

name: learning_records
sql:
CREATE TABLE learning_records (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	engineer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	predicted_diagnosis TEXT NOT NULL, 
	predicted_confidence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	confirmed_diagnosis TEXT NOT NULL, 
	actual_repair TEXT NOT NULL, 
	resolved BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	repeat_visit_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	remake_or_part_correct VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	engineer_rating INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	engineer_feedback TEXT NOT NULL, 
	anonymised_for_learning BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(engineer_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_learning_records_job_id ON learning_records (job_id)

name: photos
sql:
CREATE TABLE photos (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	original_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	phase VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id)
)

name: work_orders
sql:
CREATE TABLE work_orders (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(64), 
	job_id VARCHAR(64), 
	assigned_engineer_id INTEGER, 
	title VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	priority VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	scheduled_for VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	site_reference VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	notes TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(assigned_engineer_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
